alt.text: The cabin on the launch rail. Through the forward window the rail comes up with a sea lion sitting on the Keep clear line. There is a thump and a jolt; the overhead bins jump and the passengers start, Rook and Pip among them. The sea lion slides off, dazed and unhurt, and the rail drops away into stars.

The cabin on the launch rail. Through the forward window the rail comes up with a sea lion sitting on the Keep clear line, yapping: explain, explain again, just asking questions. The shuttle lines up on it. Rook and Pip sit strapped in among the passengers.
